nosotros.title: About us
nosotros.subtitle: Technology, verified products and personalized service — from Costa Rica.
nosotros.founderBio1: HotClick is a venture focused on buying, validating and selling outlet and high-demand products at accessible prices. We verify every product before listing it, and through our
nosotros.founderBio1End: we source specific items: send us a photo or description and we'll find it through our supplier network.
nosotros.founderBio2End: at Fidelitas. We already have a functional web app in pre-launch stage, with plans to expand into dropshipping and strategic alliances with other entrepreneurs.

informacion.title: Information
informacion.heroSub: How to buy, what product conditions mean, and answers to your most frequent questions.
informacion.howToBuySub: Step by step, simple and straightforward
informacion.step1Desc: Go to the Products section and use category, condition, and availability filters to find exactly what you're looking for. You can sort by price or name.
informacion.step2Desc: Click on any product to see its full description, condition, price, and stock availability. Make sure it's exactly what you need.
informacion.step3Desc: Select the products you want and add them to your cart. You can adjust the quantity of each item directly from the cart.
informacion.step4Desc: From the cart, press 'Order via WhatsApp'. It opens a pre-filled message with all products, quantities, and total. Just send it and we'll assist you right away.
informacion.step5Desc: Our team confirms availability, delivery time, and payment method: SINPE Móvil, bank transfer, or cash at pickup point.
informacion.step6Desc: We ship via Correos de Costa Rica nationwide, or you can arrange pickup in the GAM. We'll send you the tracking number.
informacion.conditionsSub: All our products are verified before being listed
informacion.cond1Desc: Unused product in its original packaging with all accessories. Same condition as buying in a regular store.
informacion.cond2Desc: Product barely used or returned in excellent condition. May not have original packaging but works perfectly.
informacion.cond2p2: Minimal or no signs of use
informacion.cond2p3: May be missing packaging or a minor accessory
informacion.cond3Desc: Product with visible normal use. We verified it works correctly. Ideal if you want an accessible price and don't mind minor cosmetic details.
informacion.cond3p2: May have scratches or normal wear marks
informacion.shippingSectionSub: Two options so you receive your product as you prefer
informacion.correosP1: Delivery to nearest Correos branch or home
informacion.correosP2: 1 to 5 business days depending on zone
informacion.correosP4: Cost per Correos CR rates — coordinated by client
informacion.uberP2: Available within the Greater Metropolitan Area
informacion.uberP3: Cost by distance (approx. ₡2,000–₡6,000) — at client's expense
informacion.uberP4: We coordinate the shipment via WhatsApp before confirming
informacion.uberNote: The exact Uber Flash cost is calculated in real time and shared via WhatsApp before you confirm your order.
informacion.reserveDesc: When you contact us via WhatsApp with interest in a product, we reserve the item for 1 hour so you can make your decision. If we don't receive purchase confirmation after that time, the product becomes available for the next interested client.
informacion.reservePoint1: You can request photos or video of the product via WhatsApp before confirming
informacion.reservePoint2: In the GAM you can arrange to see it in person
informacion.warrantySub: Your purchase is protected — all products include warranty
informacion.warrantyBannerDesc: All our products include a 40-day functionality warranty from the date received. If the product fails within that period, we'll resolve it without hassle.
informacion.returnStep1Desc: Write to us within 40 days of receiving the product. Describe the problem in detail.
informacion.returnStep2Desc: Attach photos or a short video showing the problem. This helps us evaluate the case faster.
informacion.returnStep3Desc: Depending on the case: we coordinate a return, product exchange, or refund. We always look for the best solution.
informacion.warrantyNote: Note: Warranty covers functionality failures. It does not apply to damage caused by misuse, drops, liquids, or product modifications. Shipping costs for returns are coordinated case by case.
informacion.faq1q: What shipping options do you have?
informacion.faq1a: We work with two modalities: Correos de Costa Rica (nationwide) and Uber Flash (same-day express in the GAM). In both cases shipping cost is at the client's expense and coordinated via WhatsApp before confirming.
informacion.faq2q: How much does Uber Flash shipping cost?
informacion.faq2a: Uber Flash cost varies by distance. We give you the exact estimate via WhatsApp before confirming. It generally ranges from ₡2,000 to ₡6,000 within the GAM.
informacion.faq3q: What payment methods do you accept?
informacion.faq3a: We accept SINPE Móvil, bank transfer, and cash at pickup point. Everything is coordinated via WhatsApp once you confirm your order.
informacion.faq4q: Can I see the product before buying?
informacion.faq4a: Yes. You can request photos or video via WhatsApp before confirming. For clients in the GAM we can also arrange an in-person viewing. Just ask us.
informacion.faq5q: How long is a product reserved when I contact via WhatsApp?
informacion.faq5a: When you contact us with interest in a product, we give you 1 hour to decide. If we don't receive confirmation after that, the product becomes available for other clients. This lets us serve everyone fairly.
informacion.faq6q: How many days of warranty do products have?
informacion.faq6a: All our products have a 40-day functionality warranty. If the product stops working within that period, contact us via WhatsApp and we'll find a solution: repair, exchange, or refund.
informacion.faq7q: How do I apply the warranty?
informacion.faq7a: Contact us via WhatsApp within 40 days of receiving the product, describe the problem, and attach a photo or video. Our team will guide you through the return or exchange process.
informacion.faq8q: How do I know if a product is available?
informacion.faq8a: Stock is shown in real time in the catalog. If it shows 'In stock' or the quantity available, the product is ready to ship. If 'Out of stock', contact us to find out when it returns.
informacion.faq9q: How can I track my order via Correos CR?
informacion.faq9a: Once shipped, we'll send you the tracking number via WhatsApp. You can use it on the Correos de Costa Rica website (correoscr.com) to check your package status.
informacion.ctaSub: Write to us directly via WhatsApp and we'll respond instantly.
